risks.mitigation: Align the persisted child-attempt logicalKey with the executeNode key and reconcile terminal attempts on resume (T001).
risks.risk: Completed-run --resume regresses terminal progress and returns BLOCKED (progress.mjs:144 'terminal progress state cannot regress'), caused by a cursor logicalKey mismatch (run-cursor.mjs:35 persists idempotencyKey without the node suffix used at index.mjs:623), so resume classifies as 'resume' not 'reconcile'.

risks.mitigation: Flush the telemetry emitter before emitting the terminal event and guard/await the final drain (T001).
risks.risk: The unguarded final telemetry drain in scripts/run-orchestrator.mjs (~:746) races the crash-path terminal event, intermittently raising 'durable JSONL changed while being read'.

risks.mitigation: Reconcile stale worker leases on resume like the run lease (T001/T004).
risks.risk: Crash-resume blocks on an unreconciled per-worker lease (worker-lease-held) from the dead process.

risks.mitigation: Persist child artifacts/evidence durably (or resolve reconcile evidence from the store) so reconcile can rehydrate without the originating host fixture (T001).
risks.risk: A true completed-run --resume reports BLOCKED 'missing': reconcile re-resolves child artifacts through the per-process host resolver, which has no durable evidence on the resumed process.
